attempts.summary: On node1 (AlmaLinux 9), created unprivileged user appsvc, installed rootless podman, enabled linger for appsvc (login-session-independent), ran an nginx:alpine container as appsvc bound to host port 8080 via rootless port mapping, and generated/enabled a systemd --user unit (container-webapp.service) so the container starts at boot without any active login session. Verified end-to-end with a full node reboot: boot_id changed, no login sessions existed post-restart, and the service and container came back up automatically serving HTTP 200 on port 8080.
